related.description: Docmost is an open-source collaborative wiki and documentation software. It is an open-source alternative to Confluence and Notion.
Self-hosted MCP server for live documentation, code audits, and best practices. 598+ curated libraries, 100+ audit patterns, no rate limits.
VSCode Extension with an MCP server that exposes semantic tools like Find Usages and Rename to LLMs
Open-source MCP server bridge for PDF Content Search — full-text PDF search + OCR for Claude/Cursor across thousands of documents.
Read-only MCP server for official Python docs: local index, no API keys, exact symbol lookup, version-aware retrieval.
